item: Existing, functioning export operation with an active, professional company profile and multi-channel digital presence
Broad product range: blocks through to finished/custom items (tombstones, fountains, sinks)
Already-established trade corridors into Libya, Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, Algeria and Romania
Stated pre-production inspection service as a built-in quality/reliability signal
Repeated, non-stone-specific ASTM test data across the marble range undermines technical credibility
No published production capacity, MOQ, lead time or certifications
No published granite-specific ASTM/technical data (only marble tested)
Egypt's national push (quarry expansion, export monitoring, ~$1bn export target) improves sector-wide supply reliability
US granite sourcing actively shifting away from Brazil; Italy's marble share gain shows buyers switch suppliers quickly
Distinctive light-toned marbles (Sunny Minya, Galala Light) align with current minimalist design trends
Turkey's dominant marble export share (~42%) and China's production scale (~34%) are structural
2026 US import data shows a softening premium natural-stone import market
India's granite price competitiveness makes New Halayeb hard to differentiate on color alone
